events.content:
I added an image for each product in app/ProductGallery.tsx, and the TypeScript check (npx tsc --noEmit -p .) passes with no errors. I didn't run a build or open the page.

- Pattern followed: app/page.tsx uses the Next.js Image component, so the gallery now imports next/image too.
- Each image: uses src={product.imageUrl}, alt={product.name}, and is 300x200 pixels.
- Loading: I left off priority, which the hero image uses. These images sit further down the page, so letting them load later is better.
- Cleanup: I removed the TODO comments.

There is no public/ folder in the project, so the image files (/product-1.jpg to /product-3.jpg) don't exist yet and will show as broken until they're added.
